title: TP2 cooperative EXL3 decode
target: Exact-shape decode kernel and tinyGLM endpoint throughput

provenance: Inspired by vcruz305/vllm-exl3 cooperative-grid decode; wrapper and kernel were not copied.
Migrated from pre-policy SparkGLM evidence without retroactive certification.

environment.model: tinyGLM exact-geometry fixture for endpoint qualification

gates.summary: Exact-shape CUDA kernel comparison matched and improved 5.5-13.9% across one to sixteen tokens.
Warmed tinyGLM endpoint gate preserved exact tokens across C1, C4, and long C2.
No broad complete-checkpoint workload qualification was retained for this isolated change.

limitations: tinyGLM throughput is integration evidence, not a full-model speed prediction.
Long C2 was flat and a broad full-checkpoint quality/workload gate was not completed.
The cooperative path therefore remains opt-in.
